This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Smothered Chicken Legs over Rice✨🍗😮‍💨 #easyrecipes #quickmeals #lazymeal #homecooking #dinnerideas RECIPE:  Ingredients: • 8–12 chicken drumsticks • Avocado oil • 2–3 tbsp butter • 1 white or yellow onion, sliced • 3 bell peppers, sliced (I used red, yellow & orange) • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 2 tbsp flour • 2½ cups chicken broth • Chopped parsley Seasonings: • Tony Chachere’s Creole seasoning • Onion powder • Garlic powder • Paprika • Thyme • Chicken bouillon • Salt & pepper Directions: 1. Add chicken drumsticks to a bowl and drizzle with avocado oil. Season generously with Tony’s, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, thyme, chicken bouillon, salt & pepper. Mix well, making sure to get the seasoning under the skin too. 2. Heat avocado oil in a pan and sear the chicken on both sides. You don’t need to cook it all the way through. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same pan, melt 2–3 tbsp butter. Add sliced onion and bell peppers. Sauté until they start to become translucent. 4. Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute. Sprinkle in 2 tbsp flour and continue cooking until the flour is incorporated and cooked out. 5. Slowly pour in 2½ cups chicken broth while stirring. Add parsley and season with Tony’s, onion powder, garlic powder, and a little more chicken bouillon. Bring to a simmer, stirring until the gravy thickens. 6. Pour the gravy and vegetables over the chicken in a baking dish. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375°F for 45–55 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. 7. Optional: Broil uncovered for a few minutes at the end to brown the chicken. 8. Serve over rice and garnish with fresh parsley.

Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Chicken pot pie with stuffing on top. perfect for when you’re craving an easy thanksgiving dinner on a weeknight. It’s creamy, delicious, and all made in one pot.  Ingredients Chicken: * 1½ lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, poultry seasoning & salt * Freshly cracked black pepper * Oil, for cooking Stuffing: * 1 package Kooshy sourdough stuffing mix * 1 medium onion, diced * 3 celery stalks, thinly sliced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tbsp butter + a little oil * 4 tbsp butter * 2 cups chicken bone broth (or chicken broth) Creamy filling: * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup all-purpose flour * 2 cups chicken bone broth (or chicken broth) * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup frozen peas & carrots * 1½ tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp poultry seasoning * ½ tsp salt * Freshly cracked black pepper * 5 sprigs fresh thyme, leaves removed Instructions 1. Season chicken with oil and all the chicken seasonings. Cook in a large oven-safe skillet until cooked through, then remove and set aside. 2. In the same skillet, add a little oil and 1 tbsp butter. Sauté onion and celery for 6–8 minutes, then add garlic and cook another 30 seconds. 3. Remove about ⅔ of the veggies and set aside. To the remaining veggies, add 4 tbsp butter and 2 cups broth. Bring to a simmer, transfer to a heat-safe measuring cup, and set aside. 4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tbsp butter and return the reserved veggies. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the remaining 2 cups broth and heavy cream, stirring until smooth. Add garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, salt, pepper, and fresh thyme. Simmer until slightly thickened. 5. Stir in frozen peas and carrots, followed by the cooked chicken. Mix until evenly coated in the creamy sauce. 6. Now prepare the stuffing. Pour the reserved warm buttery broth mixture over the sourdough stuffing mix and gently toss. Allow the bread to absorb the liquid for a few minutes, then evenly spread over the creamy chicken filling without packing it down. 7. Bake uncovered at 375°F for 20-30 minutes, until the stuffing is golden and crispy and the filling is bubbling. Serve with creamy mashed potatoes for the ultimate comfort meal. ##dinneridea##chickenpotpie##stuffing##easydinnerideas##weeknightdinner

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

Copycat Longhorn Parmesan Crusted Chicken This copycat recipe is the perfect comfort meal that tastes just as good as the restaurant. 🤍 Ingredients For the Chicken 4 chicken breasts 1 tsp each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and tsp paprika 2 tbsp oil Parmesan Ranch Topping 1 cup ranch dressing ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese 6–8 slices provolone cheese (or shredded provolone) Mozzarella cheese can be substituted Breadcrumb Topping 1 cup breadcrumbs 4 tbsp butter, melted (add more if needed) For the Mashed Potatoes 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and quartered 1 stick (½ cup) butter ⅔ cup milk Splash of heavy cream 1½ tsp salt 1 tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F and lightly spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. 2. Season both sides of the chicken breasts evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. The chicken does not need to be fully cooked.  4. In a bowl, combine the ranch dressing and shredded Parmesan cheese. 5. Place the seared chicken into the prepared baking dish. Spread the Parmesan ranch mixture evenly over each chicken breast, then top with provolone cheese. 6. Bake for 10–15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is melted and bubbly. 7. While the chicken bakes, combine the breadcrumbs and melted butter in a small bowl. Add additional butter if needed until the breadcrumbs are evenly coated. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture over the melted cheese. Return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown. Mashed Potatoes 1. Add the potatoes to a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook until fork tender, about 15–20 minutes. 2. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. 3. Add butter, milk, heavy cream, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth and creamy. Adjust seasoning to taste. 4. Serve alongside the Parmesan Crusted Chicken and enjoy! #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #easydinner #quickrecipes #parmesancrustedchicken

Creamy Roasted Onion & Garlic Chicken Pasta Sweet roasted onions, buttery garlic, and creamy Parmesan sauce. Save this for pasta night! Ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, 8 oz pasta, 1½ large onions (thinly sliced), 1 head garlic, 1½ tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp butter, ¾ tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ⅛ tsp red pepper flakes (optional), ½ cup heavy cream, ½ cup grated Parmesan, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, and ¾ cup reserved pasta water. Directions: 1. Heat oven to 400°F. Toss onions with 1 tbsp oil, butter, half the salt and pepper, and ½ tsp Italian seasoning in an 8x8 baking dish. Slice the top off garlic, drizzle with ½ tsp oil, wrap in foil, and place in dish. Roast 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden. 2. Pound chicken to ¾-inch thickness. Coat with 1 tsp oil, remaining salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, paprika, and pepper flakes. Place over onions; bake 20–25 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice. 3. Cook pasta until al dente; reserve ¾ cup pasta water. 4. Squeeze softened garlic into onions and mash. Stir in cream and ¼ cup pasta water; bake 5 minutes. Remove and let bubbling settle, then stir in Parmesan. Toss with chicken, pasta, and parsley, adding more pasta water as needed. Happy cooking! #pastalovers #easyrecipes #dinnerideasُ #comfortfood

Honey Chipotle Chicken Wraps✨🌯🌶️ #cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #mealprep #DinnerIdeas Recipe:  Ingredients- Honey Chipotle Chicken * 4-5boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced * 2 dollops Greek yogurt * 2 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (blended until smooth) * Olive oil or avocado oil * 3–4 cloves garlic, minced * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Chili powder * Cumin * Salt & pepper * Chicken bouillon * Honey (for drizzling) Homemade French Fries * 2 russet potatoes, sliced into fries * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika Creamy Chipotle Sauce * ½ cup mayonnaise * 2–3 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Garlic powder * Juice of 1 lime * Black pepper, paprika, salt  For the Wraps * Large flour tortillas * Chopped romaine lettuce * Red onion, diced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Fresh cilantro, minced * Prepared chipotle sauce Instructions 1. Prepare the chicken: Dice your chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, blended chipotle adobo peppers, a drizzle of olive oil or avocado oil, minced garlic, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a pan with oil over medium-high heat. Add your chicken and sear until nicely browned and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. 3. Add the honey: Once the chicken is fully cooked, drizzle honey over the top and toss until it coats the chicken and thickens into a sticky glaze. Remove from the pan and set aside. 4. Make the fries: Slice your russet potatoes into fries and spread them onto a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Bake at 425°F for 40–45 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy. 5. Make the chipotle sauce: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle adobo peppers, garlic powder, freshly squeezed lime juice, and black pepper. Mix until smooth and creamy. 6. Assemble your wraps: Spread a generous amount of chipotle sauce onto a large tortilla. Add chopped romaine lettuce, honey chipotle chicken, diced red onion, red and orange bell peppers, and fresh cilantro. 7. Fold and sear: Fold your tortilla into a wrap, then place it seam-side down in a lightly oiled pan. Sear until golden and crispy on both sides. 8. Serve: Wrap in parchment paper, slice in half, and serve with your homemade fries. Drizzle extra chipotle sauce over the top or serve it on the side for dipping!
